change_triggers: A source becomes outdated or is corrected
An integration contract or API changes
A workflow or data flow changes
A security or compliance assessment changes
A test reveals that the original decision was incorrect
A production incident invalidates an assumption
change_process: Record the change and its source.
Reassess evidence, assumptions, risks, and dependencies.
Determine whether clarification or new approval is required.
Mark superseded records without deleting the audit trail.
audit_rules: Do not overwrite an approved decision without preserving its history.
Record who or which authorized system made each change.
Store only the minimum necessary information in decision logs.
Do not place unnecessary patient information, credentials, or secrets in audit records.
Apply access controls and retention rules to decision history.
Keep approval evidence associated with the exact decision version.
